statements.text: Wear safety glasses when you clean the lens or mirrors.

citations.quote: Wear safety glasses when cleaning the lens or mirrors.

statements.text: Tie back long hair and loose clothing when you load material.

citations.quote: Tie back long hair and loose clothing when loading material.

statements.text: The laser can start a fire in seconds. Never leave it alone while it runs.

citations.quote: The laser can start a fire in seconds. Never leave the laser unattended while it is running.

statements.text: Stay at the machine and watch the whole job.

citations.quote: stay at the machine and watch the whole job

statements.text: Keep the lid closed while the laser is firing. Opening the lid stops the beam.

citations.quote: Keep the lid closed while the laser is firing. The lid interlock stops the beam when opened.

statements.text: Never disable, tape over or bypass the lid interlock.

citations.quote: Never disable, tape over or bypass the lid interlock.

statements.text: Run the exhaust fan and air assist for every job to remove smoke and fumes.

citations.quote: Run the exhaust fan and air assist for every job to remove smoke and fumes.

statements.text: Keep a CO2 fire extinguisher within reach of the machine.

citations.quote: Keep a CO2 fire extinguisher within reach of the machine.

statements.text: Do not look at the cutting area through the lid if the viewing window is cracked or missing.

citations.quote: Do not look at the cutting area through the lid if the viewing window is cracked or missing.

statements.text: Check that the honeycomb bed is clean and free of scraps. Scraps can catch fire.

citations.quote: Check the honeycomb bed is clean and free of scraps, which can catch fire.

statements.text: Confirm the exhaust fan and air assist are switched on.

citations.quote: Confirm the exhaust fan and air assist are switched on.

statements.text: Check that the lens is clean. A dirty lens causes flare-ups.

citations.quote: Check the lens is clean; a dirty lens causes flare-ups.

statements.text: Confirm your material is on the approved list for this machine.

citations.quote: Confirm your material is on the approved list for this machine.

statements.text: Know where the fire extinguisher and fire blanket are.

citations.quote: Know where the fire extinguisher and fire blanket are.

statements.text: Place the material flat on the bed and close the lid.

citations.quote: Place the material flat on the bed and close the lid.

statements.text: Set the focus height with the focus gauge.

citations.quote: Set focus height with the focus gauge.

statements.text: Run a frame preview before cutting to check the job fits the material.

citations.quote: Run a frame preview before cutting to check the job fits the material.

statements.text: Start the job and watch it until it finishes.

citations.quote: Start the job and watch it until it finishes.

statements.text: If a flame lasts more than a second, press pause and wait for it to go out.

citations.quote: If a flame lasts more than a second, press pause and wait for it to go out.

statements.text: After the job ends, wait 30 seconds for smoke to clear before you open the lid.

citations.quote: After the job ends, wait 30 seconds for smoke to clear before opening the lid.

statements.text: Allowed: cast and extruded acrylic up to 10 mm.

citations.quote: Allowed: cast and extruded acrylic up to 10 mm.

statements.text: Allowed: plywood and MDF up to 6 mm.

citations.quote: Allowed: plywood and MDF up to 6 mm.

statements.text: Allowed: hardwood up to 6 mm.

citations.quote: Allowed: hardwood up to 6 mm.

statements.text: Allowed: cardboard and paper.

citations.quote: Allowed: cardboard and paper.

statements.text: Allowed: vegetable-tanned leather up to 3 mm.

citations.quote: Allowed: vegetable-tanned leather up to 3 mm.

statements.text: Allowed: cotton fabric and felt.

citations.quote: Allowed: cotton fabric and felt.

statements.text: Allowed: polycarbonate up to 1 mm, for engraving only.

citations.quote: Allowed: polycarbonate up to 1 mm, for engraving only.

statements.text: Never cut PVC or vinyl. It releases chlorine gas that harms lungs and destroys the optics.

citations.quote: Never: PVC or vinyl. Cutting it releases chlorine gas that harms lungs and destroys the optics.

statements.text: Never use ABS. It melts and releases toxic fumes.

citations.quote: Never: ABS. It melts and releases toxic fumes.

statements.text: Never use HDPE or polystyrene foam. They melt and catch fire.

citations.quote: Never: HDPE or polystyrene foam. They melt and catch fire.

statements.text: Never use fiberglass or carbon fiber. The resin binder releases toxic fumes.

citations.quote: Never: fiberglass or carbon fiber. The resin binder releases toxic fumes.

statements.text: Ask staff about any material not listed, or anything with an unknown coating.

citations.quote: Ask staff: any material not listed here, or anything with an unknown coating.

statements.text: If a fire does not go out on its own within a few seconds, keep the lid closed, press the emergency stop and use the CO2 extinguisher.

citations.quote: If a fire does not go out on its own within a few seconds, keep the lid closed, press the emergency stop and use the CO2 extinguisher.

statements.text: If the fire spreads beyond the machine, leave the room and call 911.

citations.quote: If the fire spreads beyond the machine, leave the room and call 911.

statements.text: Report every flare-up to staff, even small ones.

citations.quote: Report every flare-up to staff, even small ones.
